name: bg_plate
prompt: Wide 16:9 night-time background plate for a slot machine game: a lonely American roadside gas station and convenience store at midnight. Composition, left to right: on the far left a flat canopy with flickering fluorescent tubes over two weathered old gas pumps; in the centre the convenience store front with big lit windows showing snack shelves and drink coolers, a glass door, a dark empty sign box above the door (no lettering at all); on the right an ice chest, a payphone, a newspaper box and a tall empty steel sign pole rising out of frame. Cracked wet asphalt in the foreground with puddles catching warm and red reflections, a deep blue-black starry desert sky, distant mountains. The ground line sits low, about 88% of the way down. Keep the central area calm and not too busy because a game board covers it. Lighting: warm sodium-amber light from the store and canopy, cool night-blue fill, a faint red neon wash on the right side as if from an off-screen red neon sign. Style: high-end hand-inked cartoon illustration for a premium slot game, bold confident black outlines with varied line weight, rich painterly shading, fine texture (chipped paint, rust, worn concrete, grime), small story details. Absolutely no readable text, letters, logos or brand names anywhere. No people, no cars.
